en.LiveMigrateDescription: Live migrate a virtual machine while it is running to a new host. Complete the required fields and then submit.
en.LMSubtitle: Move a running virtual machine to another host without shutting it down
en.LMBanner: Live migration copies the machine's memory to the destination host and switches over with a brief pause. Only hosts with a compatible CPU are offered.
en.LMHostHint: Compatible destinations are listed once a machine is selected.
en.LMNoHostsHint: No other host in this cloud can accept this machine.
en.LMNoHostData: no capacity data for this host
en.LMReserved: Reserved capacity after the move, not live utilization.
en.LMNothingMessage: Choose a machine and a destination to see how the move changes both hosts.
